stories.angle: The NBA Cup group assignments land tomorrow, Tuesday August 11. The full 2026-27 regular-season schedule follows Thursday, August 13. facebook.long_form:
📅 One day.

The NBA Cup slate drops tomorrow, Tuesday August 11. And then on Thursday, August 13, we get all 1,230 regular-season games for the 2026-27 season. The offseason is officially wrapping up — and basketball fans have every reason to be excited.

Here's what makes this schedule reveal different from any in recent memory:

**The Christmas Day question.** LeBron James is a Philadelphia 76er. Giannis Antetokounmpo is in Miami. Victor Wembanyama is entering his third season in San Antonio. The Knicks are the defending champions. Five games, December 25, and the NBA has never had more franchise-level stars to work with on a single date. Every possible pairing — LeBron vs. the Knicks, Giannis vs. Wemby, 76ers vs. Celtics — would be a legitimate event.

**The Knicks' banner night.** Whoever the NBA sends to crash MSG on October 20 is walking into the most hostile home opener in the league. That assignment is going to be announced Thursday.

**LeBron's Philly debut.** In 23 previous seasons, LeBron wore the Cavaliers, Heat, and Lakers. Thursday reveals when and where he first suits up as a 76er. His first road trip to New York. His first game in Boston. His first game against Giannis. Every rivalry date matters.

**The NBA Cup groups.** Tomorrow's release reveals which teams fall into which of the six groups (three per conference, five teams each) for the Emirates NBA Cup. The championship is December 11 at Hinkle Fieldhouse in Indianapolis. Those groupings are the first real scheduling news of the week.

Season tip-off: October 20. That's 71 days away.

💬 Which game are you circling the second the schedule drops?

stories.title: Kawhi Leonard — Six Weeks to Training Camp, Trade Still Frozen
stories.angle: With training camp now approximately six weeks away, the Kawhi Leonard–Raptors–Clippers saga remains completely unresolved. The NBA's salary cap investigation — which ESPN says could extend into 2027 — now includes a second undisclosed endorsement deal with Daktronics in addition to the original $28M Aspiration deal. The Raptors still haven't assumed the risk. The NBPA's arbitration threat is still active.

facebook.long_form:
⚖️ Six weeks. That's how long until NBA training camps open.

And the most complicated trade in NBA history is still completely frozen.

The Kawhi Leonard situation between the Los Angeles Clippers and the Toronto Raptors has now been unresolved for more than six weeks — and according to ESPN, the NBA's investigation could extend all the way into 2027. Here's where things stand today:

**The original probe:** The investigation centers on a $28 million endorsement deal between Leonard and Aspiration — a green bank that also held a $300 million, 23-year sponsorship deal with the Clippers franchise before going bankrupt. The NBA is examining whether the Clippers used Aspiration to funnel additional compensation to Leonard outside the salary cap.

**The expanding investigation:** CBS Sports now reports a second deal — with Daktronics, an electronics company — is also under review. The investigation isn't getting smaller. It's getting larger.

**The trade:** In late June, the Clippers and Raptors agreed on a blockbuster deal. Kawhi Leonard goes to Toronto in exchange for Brandon Ingram, Gradey Dick, and two unprotected first-round picks (2031 and 2033). The deal is agreed upon — but completely frozen while the investigation plays out.

**Toronto's dilemma:** The NBA told the Raptors they'd assume the risk of any investigation outcome if they finalize the trade before the probe concludes. That could mean completing the deal — and then having Leonard suspended, the trade unwound, or facing other penalties. So Toronto waits.

**The NBPA factor:** The players' union has warned it "wouldn't hesitate" to demand neutral arbitration if penalties are sought without sufficient evidence. Any arbitration ruling would then face a binding three-person appeals panel jointly appointed by both sides. That process has no hard deadline.

Kawhi Leonard is owed $50.3 million in 2026-27. He is technically a Clipper with no team to play for. Training camp opens in approximately six weeks.

The clock is ticking — loudly. ⏰

stories.title: Stephen Curry — 19 Days Until the Extension Window Opens
stories.angle: Stephen Curry's extension window opens in 19 days, on August 29. When he signs the expected two-year, $136.7 million deal, he would become the first NBA player in history to earn more than $60 million in a single season. The Warriors are ready. Curry is ready. The only thing left is the calendar.

x_posts.label: Post 3
x_posts.text:
19 days until Steph Curry's extension window opens.

Expected deal: 2yr/$136.7M.

When signed, his 2026-27 earnings would make him the first NBA player ever to surpass $60M in a single season.

No one has done it. Steph would be first. #Warriors #NBA

facebook.long_form:
💰 Nineteen days.

On August 29, Stephen Curry becomes eligible to sign the extension the Golden State Warriors have been waiting to offer. When it happens — and every indication is that it will — Curry's combined 2026-27 earnings would make him the first NBA player in history to surpass $60 million in a single season.

Let's put that in perspective. LeBron James's entire four-year rookie contract in 2003 was $18.8 million. The NBA's economics have transformed — but even in today's salary landscape, $60 million in one year is a number no player has ever reached.

Here's the structure:

Curry is entering the final year of his existing contract worth approximately $62.6 million in 2026-27. The expected extension — 2 years, $136.7 million total — locks him in through the 2027-28 season. The layering of his existing salary plus extension-year money pushes the 2026-27 number into historically unprecedented territory per CBS Sports.

The Warriors have no hesitation. Mutual interest is confirmed from multiple outlets. Golden State retooled this offseason: Draymond Green returned (1yr/$27.7M), Gary Payton II returned (1yr/$3.9M), and the Warriors made clear Curry is the cornerstone of whatever comes next. After a 37-45 season, they need him locked in through the rebuild.

Curry, 38, has no interest in exploring free agency. Without the extension, he would become an unrestricted free agent next summer — for the first time in his career. Everyone understands that's not happening.

The window opens August 29. Expect the signature in September.

History is 19 days away.

---

stories.title: Wembanyama and France — 10 Days Until Belgrade
stories.angle: Victor Wembanyama's return to the French national team is now 10 days away. France opens against Serbia in Belgrade on August 20, with a rematch in Orleans on August 23 before World Cup qualifiers against Slovenia and Sweden. France leads Group L 5-1. New coach Frederic Fauthoux takes the court with Wemby for the very first time.

x_posts.text:

Aug 27 — vs. Slovenia (qualifier)
Aug 30 — at Sweden (qualifier)

France leads Group L 5-1. Wemby is back. #Spurs #NBA #FIBA

facebook.long_form:
🇫🇷 10 days.

On August 20, Victor Wembanyama steps onto a court in Belgrade, Serbia, and returns to international basketball for the first time since the 2024 Paris Olympics. It's been two years. For a player who said "I don't miss the NBA at the moment, but I do miss FIBA," this homecoming has been a long time coming.

Here's the August schedule for France:

- **August 20** — Exhibition vs. Serbia (Belgrade)
- **August 23** — Exhibition vs. Serbia (Orleans)
- **August 27** — 2027 FIBA World Cup qualifier vs. Slovenia (home)
- **August 30** — 2027 FIBA World Cup qualifier at Sweden (away)

France enters this window leading Group L at 5-1 after the first qualifying round. Add Wembanyama, Rudy Gobert, and Evan Fournier — the three who shared the court at the Paris Olympics — and this French team is one of the most dangerous national squads in the world.

The added intrigue: new France head coach Frederic Fauthoux, who took over from Vincent Collet after the Olympics, has never coached Wembanyama at the senior national level. August 20 in Belgrade is their debut together.

The Spurs didn't just send Wemby. Coaches and staff made the trip to Paris too, supporting his development through the national team window. That kind of organizational investment in a 22-year-old is extraordinary — and says everything about where San Antonio believes this franchise is headed.

The NBA doesn't tip off for another 71 days. But August 20 in Belgrade is appointment basketball.

---

stories.title: Philadelphia 76ers — The East's Most Compelling Training Camp Storyline
stories.angle: With training camp roughly seven weeks out, the Philadelphia 76ers are emerging as the most-discussed team in the Eastern Conference. LeBron James, Joel Embiid, Tyrese Maxey, Jaylen Brown, and Jared Edgecombe represent five combined MVP awards and a championship pedigree. LeBron and Maxey are already in the gym before sunrise. Embiid completed his healthiest offseason in years. The East is loaded — but no team's arrival generates more intrigue than this one.

x_posts.label: Post 5
x_posts.text:
The 2026-27 Philadelphia 76ers are going to be something else.

LeBron James. Joel Embiid. Tyrese Maxey. Jaylen Brown. Jared Edgecombe.

Training camp opens in late September.

They're already in the gym before sunrise. #Sixers #NBA

facebook.long_form:
🔑 Seven weeks to training camp. And the Philadelphia 76ers are already the most-discussed team in the Eastern Conference.

LeBron James. Joel Embiid. Tyrese Maxey. Jaylen Brown. Jared Edgecombe. Five players. Five combined MVP awards. A two-time Finals MVP. A championship culture transplant from Boston. And the greatest player of his generation, in his final act, betting on Philadelphia.

The Eastern Conference is as loaded as it has been in years. The New York Knicks are the defending champions — they have a championship core returning intact. The Miami Heat added Giannis Antetokounmpo in one of the biggest trades in league history. The Boston Celtics remain built to compete. The 76ers are walking into all of that as the new arrival.

And everything you're hearing out of Philadelphia suggests they're ready.

Tyrese Maxey has been in the gym at 6:15 AM — beating LeBron James to the facility. LeBron, reportedly amused and impressed, has made a point of matching that intensity. Joel Embiid completed his most restriction-free offseason in years. 76ers president Mike Gansey said it directly: "One of the first offseasons he is healthy going into it."

LeBron called his Philadelphia signing "the last decision" of his career. He doesn't say things like that lightly. This is not a victory lap or a PR move. The 76ers genuinely believe they have a championship-caliber roster — and the daily footage out of their facility suggests the players believe it too.

Training camp opens late September. The Eastern Conference race begins in earnest October 20.

The most interesting team in the East? Right now, it's not even close. 🏀

---
